instructions.name: arm_guard
docs: Starts the inactivity clock once the treasury is funded. Permissionless, once.

instructions.name: bind_pool
docs: Permissionless: reads the live DBC config + pool and proves the launch is
treasury-safe before anyone should buy.

instructions.name: claim_lp_fees
docs: Permissionless: after migration, claims the LP fees of the DAMM v2 position that DBC
minted to the partner (= the treasury). The treasury earns trading fees forever.

instructions.name: collect_surplus
docs: Permissionless: if the last buy overshot the threshold, pulls the partner surplus.

instructions.name: collect_trading_fees
docs: Permissionless: pulls the partner share of DBC trading fees into the treasury.

instructions.name: declare_abandoned
docs: Ghost-team protection: if the team has not requested a tranche for `inactivity_secs`,
anyone can turn the treasury into a redemption pool for holders.

instructions.name: defend_floor
docs: Permissionless: when the token trades on DAMM v2 below what the treasury holds per
token, spend floor reserve + collected fees buying it back, and burn what is bought.
The program sets the minimum output itself, so the treasury can only ever pay a price at
or below backing: every buyback raises the backing of the remaining tokens.

accounts.name: damm_pool
docs: minimum output protects the treasury whichever pool is passed.

instructions.name: draw_budget
docs: Team draws what has accrued this period, capped by what is still un-advanced on its
next tranche. Only while the raise is Funded.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Permissionless after the window: releases the tranche, or flips the raise into
liquidation if the reject quorum was met.

instructions.name: harvest
docs: Permissionless: after graduation, pulls the partner migration fee into the
treasury by CPI into DBC, signed by the treasury PDA (the config's fee_claimer).

instructions.name: init_guard
docs: Team opts the raise into the guard before it is funded (usually in the launch transaction).

instructions.name: init_raise
docs: Team registers a raise for a DBC config it is about to create (or has created).

instructions.name: observe
docs: Records the DAMM v2 price for the guard's on-chain TWAP. Permissionless crank.

instructions.name: propose_release
docs: Team requests the next milestone tranche, committing to evidence of the delivered work
(a link plus a hash); opens the challenge window.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: In liquidation: burn base tokens, receive a pro-rata share of the treasury.

instructions.name: reject
docs: Holder locks base tokens as a "reject" vote on the active proposal.

instructions.name: tender_offer
docs: On-chain Bedrock clause. The only way to take over a raise is a tender offer to every
holder: the acquirer tops the treasury up until each circulating token redeems for at
least TWAP × (1 + premium). The raise then pays holders out pro rata and the acquirer
becomes its `team`.

instructions.name: withdraw_vote
docs: Returns a voter's locked tokens once their proposal has been finalized.

types.name: Budget
docs: Operating budget between milestones (MetaDAO-style monthly allowance, but bounded):
each period the team may draw `monthly_amount`, as an ADVANCE on its next tranche. The
next tranche pays the rest; draws stop when the raise is liquidated (rejection, silence
or takeover), and silence still triggers the ghost-team switch.

fields.name: start_at
docs: Start of the first period (first draw).

fields.name: advanced_unsettled
docs: Advances not yet netted against a released tranche.

fields.name: monthly_amount
docs: Quote atoms the team may draw per period.

fields.name: inactivity_secs
docs: Ghost-team protection: seconds without a tranche request after which anyone can
return the treasury to holders.

fields.name: armed_at
docs: When the inactivity clock started (set by `arm_guard` once the raise is funded).

fields.name: buyout_premium_bps
docs: On-chain Bedrock clause: premium over the TWAP that any takeover must pay every holder.

fields.name: observe_interval_secs
docs: Minimum spacing between price observations (twap_window / 8).

fields.name: acquirer
docs: Set when a takeover happened.

fields.name: inactivity_secs
docs: Seconds the team may go without requesting a tranche before holders get the treasury back.

fields.name: buyout_premium_bps
docs: Premium over the TWAP a takeover must pay every holder (bps; Bedrock uses 3000 = +30%).

fields.name: tranche_bps
docs: Share of the payable treasury (funded minus floor reserve) released at this milestone, in bps.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: SHA-256 the team committed to when requesting this tranche (e.g. a release or commit hash).

fields.name: price_q64
docs: DAMM v2 price, quote atoms per base atom, Q64.64.

types.name: Raise
docs: One raise = one DBC config = one DBC pool.
The treasury PDA (seeds: ["treasury", dbc_config]) is set as the DBC config's
`fee_claimer` and `leftover_receiver`, so every partner-side flow of the launch
(migration fee, partner trading fees, surplus, leftover, and — on transfer-hook
configs — the mint authority) can only be moved by this program.

fields.name: min_treasury_pct
docs: Minimum `migration_fee_percentage` the DBC config must route to the treasury.

fields.name: funded_amount
docs: Quote amount harvested into the treasury at graduation.

fields.name: released_amount
docs: Quote amount already released to the team.

fields.name: fees_collected
docs: Extra quote collected after funding: DBC partner trading fees, partner surplus and
DAMM v2 LP fees of the treasury-owned position. Never released to the team: it backs NAV.

fields.name: floor_reserve_bps
docs: Share of `funded_amount` kept forever as a floor reserve (bps). Tranches split the rest.

fields.name: floor_spent
docs: Quote spent by `defend_floor` buying tokens below backing.

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Base tokens bought back by `defend_floor` and burned.

fields.name: challenge_window
docs: Seconds holders have to reject a proposed tranche.

fields.name: reject_quorum_bps
docs: Share of base-token supply (bps) that must lock "reject" votes to block a tranche.

fields.name: proposal_nonce
docs: Active proposal (valid while a milestone is `Proposed`).

fields.name: proposal_evidence_uri
docs: Link to the delivered work for the active (or last) tranche request.

types.name: RaiseState
docs: Lifecycle of a raise.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: A holder's locked "reject" vote on one proposal.
